<function name="MotionSensorPos" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the position of a Kinect bone.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="bone" type="number">Bone to get the position of. Must be from 0 to 19.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Vector">Position of the bone.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
